events.subtitle: with Kenwood Dennard and Wes Wirth
events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore lists Stanley Jordan for Friday and Saturday, October 2-3, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets both nights. Stanley Jordan's official tour calendar independently identifies both Baltimore dates as a trio with Kenwood Dennard and Wes Wirth. Jordan's official biography identifies his signature instrumental language as the two-handed guitar touch technique.

en.why_it_matters: Jordan's touch technique is the reason this clears RADAR: he turns the guitar into a genuinely polyphonic instrument, and Baltimore gets the touring trio with Kenwood Dennard and Wes Wirth rather than a generic billing. Four sets in Keystone's close listening-room scale make that instrumental identity unusually easy to hear up close.
en.trip_verdict: Baltimore is an easy short-trip option; choose whichever of the four sets fits the weekend and make an evening of it rather than reorganizing a larger regional itinerary around the engagement.

es.why_it_matters: La técnica de touch de Jordan es la razón para meterlo al RADAR: convierte la guitarra en un instrumento realmente polifónico, y Baltimore recibe al trío de gira con Kenwood Dennard y Wes Wirth, no un cartel genérico. Cuatro sets en la escala cercana de Keystone permiten escuchar esa identidad instrumental con especial claridad.
es.trip_verdict: Baltimore funciona como salida corta y sencilla; escogería el set que mejor acomode ese fin de semana y armaría la noche alrededor de él, sin reorganizar un itinerario regional más grande por toda la residencia.
